title: [Wear] Complications designated Tap for action stops working a short while after app/tile is visited
body:
Complications work better in 3.3 than ever before. Now wear app, tiles and their actions works when using external watchfaces with complications.

However, after testing complications abit more I notice that when you tap the complications the configured action fails to start unless you visit a tile or app right before. After a few seconds tap for action stops working again. 

I did a quick check and this was also broken in 3.1 and 3.2 so it's not caused by 3.3 changes.

comments.body: Is this still an issue? The panel commands not working on non AAPS watch faces was solved a while back on the dev branch but I'm curious if it is still not working on the master branch. Will be upgrading phones this week and am curious which branch I should use.

Just following up on if this is still an issue? I can't find anything in the release notes for the master branch. 

This was fixed some time ago in dev, but I just want to confirm if the fix is also now live in master as I will be upgrading phones this weekend and am not sure which branch to build.
I will check when I have time. Haven't tested with 3.3.2.1 or latest dev
Still happens with 3.3.2.1. Will test latest dev later. You need to wait a few minutes for tap for action stops working

Thank you for checking!

I will stick with Dev for now, especially because the master version of the wear app keeps failing in Android Studio due to some sort of version mismatch that I can't resolve.

So issue still occurs for me on latest dev also. For my test-rig I got a Samsung GW 4. Not sure what watch you are using. Are you sure that tap for action on the complications works after a few minutes idle, without visiting a tile first?

Complications tap for action stops working with this build also @MilosKozak . I've tried many different things myself also without any luck so far. It takes a few minutes, then nothing happens when tapping them. Visiting a tile and back to watchface wakes up the tap to action for complications as before. 

Everything else seem to be working fine.

@MilosKozak I've built wear app based on https://github.com/nightscout/AndroidAPS/tree/complication - You seemed to have fixed this issue. Great job :) I'll test abit more to see that everything else on wear tiles, complications is working as before. I'll update tomorrow.
I can't see any issues, complications working fine and tap to action. Tested all tiles also.
